key_insight: A reset-free LUCI error-correction approach can suppress logical errors on IBM hardware even with nearly half the syndrome density in time.
engineering_relevance: This suggests quantum error-correction codes can be made more hardware-tolerant and flexible, reducing reliance on rigid syndrome circuits and static connectivity constraints.
method: Benchmarked a reset-free LUCI framework on IBM quantum hardware.
Asymmetrically scaled the X or Z code distance to target specific logical Pauli errors.
Compared LUCI against the standard rotated surface code under reduced temporal syndrome extraction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports logical error-suppression ratios of 1.75(10) for X and 1.93(12) for Z under LUCI, versus 1.58(13) and 2.44(7) for the standard approach.
watch_item: The reset-free LUCI setup needs two subroutine rounds for full syndrome extraction, so reduced temporal distance and circuit overhead remain practical concerns.
paper_title: LUCI on IBM Hardware: Error Suppression with Almost Half Syndrome Density
